reason: The submitted CIF parses and symmetry-expands in Immm (No. 71) to a fully occupied, ordered 18-atom conventional cell K4Th2F12 (Z=2; reduced K2ThF6); primitive standardization gives one K2ThF6 formula unit (9 atoms, 165.112 A^3), so setting or Z does not create another structure. Indexing covers 20/20 selected lines (M20=69.4), and all 66 observed peaks with prominence >1 are within 0.08 degrees of an instantiated-CIF reflection, with no important off-line residual. The trace's symmetry-distinct site search converged on the submitted Immm realization with objective 0.00441 versus 0.08148 for the next listed assignment, and repeated searches converged to the same coordinates. An independent profile calculation from the submitted CIF reproduces Rwp-like 4.30% over 10-75 degrees and 4.59% over 5-90 degrees, close to Pawley-style bounds of 3.34% and 3.65%; residual maxima occur at represented peaks rather than unexplained reflections. Formal charges K(+1), Th(+4), and F(-1) balance, bond-valence analysis selects those oxidation states, and complete periodic shells show Th-F 4x2.319 plus 4x2.465 A and K-F 2.709-2.808 A with no overlaps (correcting the trace's truncated 4+2 Th description to 4+4). I-centering is supported by absences, the subgroup coordinate search collapses to Immm, and competing site assignments fit far worse; no concrete viable incompatible ordering, symmetry, superstructure, or framework branch survives.
